title: Restore operational history after local store loss
goal: Restore the retained work and evidence needed to resume after losing local operational records.
context: The current engineering definition survives but its operational history is unavailable.
trigger: The engineer selects a retained backup and requests restoration.
preconditions: The actor explicitly identifies the project and intended scope.
Any requested mutation is subject to applicable project authority.

interaction.action: Selects the backup, project and intended restoration destination.
Reports source identity, coverage, compatibility and any destination conflict.
Requests restoration within the applicable authority.
Reports the restored scope and original assessment bases or the precise failure and remaining destination state.

expected_outcome: The selected retained operational scope is available with its original identities and evidence meaning, and the engineer can judge its fitness for resumption.

alternatives.condition: The current model has advanced since the backup.
alternatives.outcome: The restored records retain their earlier subject basis and make no renewed applicability claim.

failures.condition: The backup is missing, corrupt, incomplete or incompatible.
failures.outcome: Restoration does not activate an incomplete history and preserves unrelated destination content.

failures.condition: Destination work differs from the selected restoration basis.
failures.outcome: The system reports a conflict without silently replacing newer work.
The outcome identifies incomplete restoration; a later explicit retry checks actual destination state before proceeding.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
